headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 9, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Reynaldo López earning the win and Didier Fuentes notching the save. The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Chicago White Sox 9-5, led by Brandon Marsh's 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. The New York Yankees shut down the Boston Red Sox 6-1, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the way at the plate.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. Carlos Rodriguez of the Milwaukee Brewers was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026. The Los Angeles Angels have placed Adam Frazier on the 10-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, Vaughn Grissom with a left oblique strain, and Yoán Moncada with right knee inflammation. The Houston Astros have placed Nick Allen on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain, while the Seattle Mariners have placed J.P. Crawford on the 10-day injured list with a right hand contusion.

Several teams have made roster moves, including trades. The Colorado Rockies acquired Richie Martin Jr. from the Texas Rangers for cash. The Los Angeles Dodgers traded LHP Antoine Kelly to the Chicago Cubs for cash, while the Athletics traded RHP Joel Kuhnel to the Milwaukee Brewers for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded LHP Joe La Sorsa to the Boston Red Sox, and the Cincinnati Reds traded RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Edge Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a 3-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Reynaldo López earning the win and Didier Fuentes notching the save.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 9-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Brandon Marsh leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jonathan Bowlan pitched 2 strong innings for the White Sox, striking out 3 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Down Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Boston Red Sox, winning 6-1 behind a strong team effort. Jazz Chisholm Jr. led the way at the plate with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dropped a 4-6 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays in their latest matchup. Taylor Ward led the Orioles at the plate with a home run and two RBIs, while Adam Macko earned the win with a strong relief outing.

top_news.title: **Mariners Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles in their recent matchup. Josh Naylor and Randy Arozarena were among the impact hitters for the winning team, while Dominic Canzone and Taylor Ward also made notable contributions.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Fall to Rays in 1-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox suffered a 1-3 loss to the Tampa Bay Rays, with Marcelo Mayer and Yandy Díaz leading the way for their respective teams. Connelly Early pitched a strong game for the winning Rays.

top_news.title: **Brewers RHP Rodriguez Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Carlos Rodriguez has been placed on the 15-day injured list, retroactive to May 31, 2026. Rodriguez's status change comes as the Brewers navigate their current season schedule.

top_news.title: **Rockies Acquire Richie Martin Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies have acquired shortstop Richie Martin Jr. in a trade with the Texas Rangers, who received cash in return.
